slack.note: Drafts posted to self-DM via stage-slack-draft.js. Requires chat:write + im:write scopes.

outlook.note: Phase 3 — blocked on Azure App permissions. Browser compose auto-saves to Drafts.

teams.note: Teams is scanned via the Outlook skill. Draft staging deferred.

jira.note: Drafts written to {vault}/drafts/ as MD fragments via stage-local-draft.js.

confluence.note: Read-only by default. Enable draft_enabled to generate page comment drafts as local MD fragments.

github_com.note: PR reviews: pending review via API (stage-github-review.js). Issue comments: local MD fragments.

github_corp.note: Same as github_com but uses GITHUB_CORP_TOKEN and GITHUB_CORP_BASE_URL.

ai_radar.note: Read-only. RSS/GitHub/HTML watch triage. No draft staging.

_draft_methods.slack_dm: Post to self-DM channel via Slack API (stage-slack-draft.js)
_draft_methods.github_api: PR reviews: pending review via GitHub API (stage-github-review.js). Issues: local MD.
_draft_methods.browser: Claude in Chrome compose box (auto-saves to tool's native drafts)
_draft_methods.none: No draft staging for this tool
